app_store.name: Resound: Pure Music Player
app_store.subtitle: True Shuffle & Synced Lyrics
app_store.promotional_text: Experience true random shuffle where every track plays once. Stream pure music with zero podcasts, zero clutter, and synchronized lyrics on every track.
app_store.description:
Resound is designed for listeners who want pure music without algorithmic clutter, podcast feeds, or repetitive shuffle loops.

Key Highlights:
- True Random Shuffle: Powered by the Fisher-Yates shuffle engine so every track in your playlist plays exactly once before any repeat.
- Pure Music Focus: Zero podcasts, audiobooks, or auto-playing video clips taking up your screen.
- Real-Time Synced Lyrics: Karaoke-style synchronized lyrics on every track without monthly limits or paywalls.
- Lightweight Performance: Sub-second response times and minimal memory footprint.
- Instant Play: Start listening immediately with no mandatory sign-up.
app_store.whats_new: Introducing Resound with the Fisher-Yates True Shuffle engine and live synchronized karaoke lyrics.
